Name: PCI-DSS v4.0 (Payment Card Industry) for OCI
Description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS v4.0) requirements for securing cardholder data environments across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

Requirements.Name: Requirement 1: Install and Maintain Network Security Controls
Requirements.Description: Deploy and maintain Network Security Groups (NSGs) and Security Lists to restrict traffic to and from the Cardholder Data Environment (CDE).

Attributes.Section: Build and Maintain a Secure Network and Systems

Requirements.Name: Requirement 1.2: Restrict Ingress & Egress Traffic Boundaries
Requirements.Description: Inbound and outbound traffic to and from the cardholder data environment is restricted to that which is necessary.

Attributes.Section: Build and Maintain a Secure Network and Systems

Requirements.Name: Requirement 2: Apply Secure Configurations to All System Components
Requirements.Description: Ensure system default accounts and passwords are changed, and disable unnecessary services and legacy metadata endpoints on compute instances.

Attributes.Section: Build and Maintain a Secure Network and Systems

Requirements.Name: Requirement 3: Protect Stored Account Data
Requirements.Description: Store account data only as long as necessary and render Primary Account Numbers (PAN) unreadable anywhere it is stored.

Requirements.Name: Requirement 3.4: Protect Account Data at Rest with Strong Cryptography
Requirements.Description: Render PAN unreadable using customer-managed encryption keys (CMK) across block volumes, boot volumes, and object storage.

Requirements.Name: Requirement 3.5: Cryptographic Key Management & Rotation
Requirements.Description: Protect cryptographic keys used for encryption of cardholder data against disclosure and misuse with automated key rotation.

Requirements.Name: Requirement 4: Protect Cardholder Data with Strong Cryptography during Transmission
Requirements.Description: Ensure strong cryptography and security protocols are used when cardholder data is transmitted over open, public networks.

Requirements.Name: Requirement 6: Develop and Maintain Secure Systems and Software
Requirements.Description: Identify and manage security vulnerabilities using Oracle Cloud Guard and apply security patches in a timely manner.

Requirements.Name: Requirement 7: Restrict Access to System Components and Cardholder Data
Requirements.Description: Access to system components and data is limited to only those individuals whose jobs require such access (least privilege).

Requirements.Name: Requirement 8: Identify Users and Authenticate Access to System Components
Requirements.Description: Assign unique identification to each person with access to systems and enforce strong passwords and credential lifecycle policies.

Requirements.Name: Requirement 8.2: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Enforcement
Requirements.Description: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for all administrative and console access into the cardholder data environment.

Requirements.Name: Requirement 10: Log and Monitor All Access to System Components and Cardholder Data
Requirements.Description: Capture comprehensive audit logs, retain audit history for at least 365 days, and monitor for unauthorized changes.

Requirements.Name: Requirement 11: Test Security of Systems and Networks Regularly
Requirements.Description: Continuously test and verify network security perimeter controls and database exposure.

Requirements.Name: Requirement 12: Support Information Security with Organizational Policies
Requirements.Description: Maintain organizational security governance and backup procedures for all critical systems.
